thread:
Maria: Heads up — coordinating a quick preflight for tonight's 18:00 UTC change window. Need API, runtime, console, and router teams to confirm compatibility and release-note handoff. Pin plan: api=3.2.1, runtime=2.0.0-beta5, console=1.8.0, router=1.4.0-compat.

Chris: Quick Q — why beta5 for runtime? are we sure it's safe for dedicated pools?

Maria: Beta5 has the kernel fixes for KV eviction we need. Raj validated perf on a small dedicated pool earlier today. We still do canary first.

Tessa: Console note: the UI toggle for the new rollout is off by default. We'll flip it after the canary if metrics look good. Also added release notes draft to the PR: https://git.internal/release-notes/4567 (please sanity check).

Raj: Runtime canary queued from my end. Deploy-bot shows queue id: 98321. I will run the 20-node smoke set after router flips.

Chris: Router compat — we need to ensure header split doesn't break header-based routing. Router v1.4.0-compat still honors legacy header x-rd-target, right?

Tessa: yes, compat build keeps x-rd-target and adds router.header_split=false by default. We'll enable header_split in rollout #2.

deploy-bot: queued: runtime-canary(98321) -> api-canary(98322). Estimated start: 18:05 UTC. Will post deploy logs to /deploy-logs/98321.

Maria: Smoke checklist (short):
- runtime canary on eu-west small pool (20 nodes)
- api canary (5%) routed to canary runtime
- console toggle off 
- router compat in front of canary
- tracing enabled, sampling=100% for canary
- alert thresholds: p95 latency > 500ms OR 5% error rate OR KV-miss spike > 3x

Chris: copy. I'll run quick health checks command after canary.

Chris: health check commands I use:
```
curl -H 'x-rd-target: canary' -X POST https://api.internal/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' -i
kubectl -n runtime logs -l app=runtime-canary | tail -n 200
```

Raj: deploying runtime canary now. posting initial logs in thread.

deploy-bot: runtime-canary(98321) started at 18:05:12 UTC. 3/20 nodes live.

Maria: I'll watch latency dashboard. Chris, can you watch errors and tracers? Tessa watch console events. Raj watch KV/cache hit ratios.

Chris: on it. first few requests look OK. p50=45ms, p95=210ms. errors=0 so far.

Tessa: console events present and attributed to runtime-canary. UIs render fallback correctly.

deploy-bot: runtime-canary(98321) 20/20 nodes live. health: healthy. routing: 5% traffic to canary.

Maria: good — starting api canary now.

deploy-bot: api-canary(98322) started at 18:12:03 UTC.

Chris: api smoke: happy path requests succeed, no obvious schema break. tokenization looks consistent.

Raj: KV miss rate jumped ~2.5x immediately but latency stable. Possibly cache warmup — will monitor next 10 min.

Maria: abort criteria reminder: any of these -> abort and rollback:
- p95 > 500ms sustained (5m)
- errors > 5% sustained (2m)
- KV cache RR > 3x spike
- console rendering regressions or missing features reported by QA

Chris: seeing a small spike in 18:18 window but below thresholds. keeping an eye.

Tessa: QA ran quick flows; one minor console link 404 (logged in PR comments). Not blocking for canary but noted for post-canary fix.

deploy-bot: api-canary(98322) routing increased to 25% after 10m stable.

Maria: If all teams still good at 25%, we'll do staged lift to 100% with router header_split still off and console toggle remaining off until midnight. Rollforward to pinned versions only after post-rollout verification.

Raj: agree. also leaving ability to pin back to runtime 1.9.x in router routing table if we need an emergency fallback. I've kept the pin route ready.

Chris: thumbs up. I'll draft the short release-note blurb for support: what changed, rollback steps, known post-canary todos.

Tessa: :thumbsup: tagging support and docs on the PR.

Maria: final checkpoint at 18:40 UTC — unless someone calls abort, we proceed to staged lift. Callout: add a short note in release notes about the console link 404.

Chris: ack.

Tessa: ack.

Raj: ack.

deploy-bot: staged lift started: increasing runtime routing to 50% then 100% over 30m. Will post updates.

Maria: thanks everyone — will follow up with final release-note and postmortem checklist tomorrow.
